description: Boundaries that can emit generation activity. Each entry must state whether it is instrumented, not applicable to this generation branch, unsupported, or limited. Never describe the trace as complete while any active boundary is unsupported.

boundaries.detail: Instrumented at the shared completion boundary; emits start, visible output, usage and normalized status.
Legacy OpenRouter dispatch is observed through the shared completion boundary.
Provider-hosted web search tool. Starts and completions can be observed; internal provider tool actions cannot.
OpenCode Go calls pass a producer with reference-analysis stage and route substep. The direct legacy OpenRouter caller remains unobserved.
OpenCode Go calls pass visual-gate stage, mode, and candidate/repair context when supplied by rendered repair. The direct legacy OpenRouter caller remains unobserved.

OpenCode Go fidelity/diversity calls pass judge stage and substep; individual fidelity includes candidate and repair pass when available. Diversity is a multi-candidate action without an invented candidate ID. The direct legacy OpenRouter caller remains unobserved.
OpenCode Go repair dispatches pass actual candidate and applied repair cycle context. Standalone callers without a cycle leave repairPass null. Direct legacy OpenRouter calls remain unobserved.
OpenCode Go image review dispatches pass contextual-imagery stage and placement substep. The direct legacy OpenRouter caller remains unobserved.
The shared boundary supports observation; this caller does not yet pass a producer.
The shared boundary supports observation; this caller does not yet pass a producer.
The shared boundary supports observation; this caller does not yet pass a producer.
Provider-side tool execution and reasoning are not observable and are never inferred.
Lifecycle stage evidence stays authoritative in the existing stage timeline; the diagnostic trace does not duplicate it.
OpenCode Go copy dispatch is observed. The legacy OpenRouter copy dispatch remains limited and reports coverage status limited.

Each route's actual generation/reuse/fallback operation emits action start/finish and safe aggregate result counts. Individual FAL requests and provider internals are not separately traced; prompts and provider URLs are never projected.
Candidate authoring is wrapped as a real pipeline action; each model dispatch is observed separately.

Actual bakeoff, deterministic hero check, candidate repair, visual checks and human revision checks emit action start/finish. Candidate and repair pass are included where applicable; whole-bakeoff actions have no single candidate. Promotion/upload and internal browser operations are not individually traced.
The workflow shell deploys the preview; no diagnostic producer runs inside the deployment step.
Authoritative lifecycle telemetry must never depend on the diagnostic trace.
Queue time before a job starts is not observable from inside the run.
The only producer allowed to declare the trace complete; runs after every workflow outcome.
